Compliance Reporting.name: Manual Compliance Audit Preparation
Compliance Reporting.definition: Pain around slow, manual compliance evidence collection and report generation for audits, including lack of on-demand reporting, duplicated effort across overlapping frameworks, audit deadline pressure, and evidence gaps such as log retention.

Compliance Reporting.name: Comply module adoption and framework needs
Compliance Reporting.definition: Statements about the Comply compliance reporting module: framework coverage needs (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR), readiness guidance, adoption and underutilisation, implementation and integration effort, on-demand reporting as upsell or differentiator, and release issues.

Compliance Reporting.name: HIPAA Compliance for Healthcare Customers
Compliance Reporting.definition: Healthcare customers' HIPAA-driven needs and gaps, spanning Comply reporting coverage and accuracy, audit evidence, and HIPAA-mandated backup retention, encryption and continuity.

Compliance Reporting.name: PCI DSS Compliance Reporting Needs
Compliance Reporting.definition: Customer requirements, pain points, and expansion plans centered on PCI DSS compliance reporting, audit evidence, and related framework coverage in Comply.

Platform Reliability.name: Outage fallout and competitive risk
Platform Reliability.definition: Statements about the impact of a recent platform outage — eroded reliability trust, requests for root-cause incident reports and remediation documentation, compliance monitoring gaps, and competitors exploiting the outage or pricing to win deals.

Platform Reliability.name: Ingestion Pipeline Single Point Failure
Platform Reliability.definition: Statements about the Detect event ingestion pipeline's non-redundant single node and missing circuit breaker, the resulting cascading outages and lost threat visibility, and related remediation work (failover, circuit breaker tuning, testing, monitoring).

Platform Reliability.name: Detect Ingestion Pipeline Outage
Platform Reliability.definition: Statements about the cascading failure/outage of the Detect threat detection event ingestion and processing pipeline caused by a single point of failure, its loss of alerts and visibility, and related follow-ups such as missing workarounds, retroactive analysis, and backlog items.

Platform Reliability.name: Detect outage eroding customer trust
Platform Reliability.definition: Statements about past threat detection outages and pipeline reliability concerns that have eroded customer and executive confidence, including requests for health visibility, reliability assurance, and related compliance exposure.

Platform Reliability.name: Detect Ingestion Pipeline Outage
Platform Reliability.definition: Multi-hour outages of the Detect threat detection event ingestion pipeline caused by a single point of failure, leading to lost monitoring visibility, late internal detection, and reliability concerns.

Backup and Recovery.name: Backup Job Performance and Restore Gaps
Backup and Recovery.definition: Issues with Protect backup operations including slow or failing backup jobs, scheduler scaling, agent coverage, fragmented visibility, and limited file-level restore and recovery objective assurance.

Identity & Authentication.name: Identity SSO and QA Testing Gaps
Identity & Authentication.definition: Issues with Identity product authentication (SSO/SAML, MFA/TOTP, SCIM provisioning, session timeouts, certificate handling in connectors) alongside QA/test coverage and release-process gaps that let regressions through.

Identity.name: MFA and Access Management Gaps
Identity.definition: Issues with identity and access management including inconsistent or inflexible MFA enforcement, fragmented SSO tooling, role/permission model limitations, privileged access and offboarding gaps, and perceived immaturity of the Identity product.

Comply Product.name: Comply Report and Control-Mapping Gaps
Comply Product.definition: Limitations in Comply's compliance reports and framework handling, including missing cross-framework control mapping, inflexible/static report formats, missing frameworks or sections, annotation/tagging gaps, and usability or documentation issues.

Incident Management.name: Lack of Proactive Outage Communication
Incident Management.definition: Statements about Aegis failing to proactively notify customers of platform outages, slow or insufficient status page updates, and related gaps in incident detection, communication, and outage impact.

Implementation & Onboarding.name: Onboarding and integration setup effort
Implementation & Onboarding.definition: Concerns about the effort, manual configuration, and limited engineering bandwidth involved in onboarding, attribute mapping, SSO/SIEM connector setup, and custom integrations.

Customer Communication.name: Lack of Proactive Customer Notification
Customer Communication.definition: Failures to proactively inform customers (and customer-facing teams) about known defects, incidents, fixes, releases, or resolution timelines, leading to wasted troubleshooting and escalations.

Billing & Invoicing.name: Unexpected Overage and Proration Charges
Billing & Invoicing.definition: Customers surprised by invoice overage charges above contracted tiers or proration errors, often due to lack of usage visibility or missing proactive threshold alerts, leading to billing disputes.

Customer Support.name: Slow Support Response Times
Customer Support.definition: Complaints about slow initial support responses, long waits, unresolved or unfollowed tickets, and difficulty escalating priority or critical cases.

Product Roadmap.name: Roadmap Timeline Uncertainty
Product Roadmap.definition: Customer frustration or skepticism about missing committed delivery dates and visibility for requested roadmap features, plus related deadline pressure on deployments and internal sprint capacity.

Commercial & Contracts.name: Renewal Pricing and Contract Terms
Commercial & Contracts.definition: Customer negotiations and concerns around renewal price increases, budget constraints, multi-year versus annual commitments, procurement approval, and contract flexibility for seat or usage growth.

Detection & Alerting.name: Alerting Latency and Reliability Gaps
Detection & Alerting.definition: Issues where alert delivery, routing, severity scoring, deduplication, or self-monitoring is delayed, degraded, or missing, slowing detection of and response to critical events.

Threat Detection.name: Detect False Positives and Alert Fatigue
Threat Detection.definition: Issues where Detect generates excessive false-positive or low-signal alerts due to poor tuning, baselines, or thresholds, burdening small security teams with triage and fatigue (including one positive mention of reduced noise).

Reliability & Contracts.name: Uptime SLA Breaches and Credits
Reliability & Contracts.definition: Outages that breach contractual uptime SLAs, customer demands for service credits or compensation, and requests for stronger or formalized SLA terms as a condition of renewal.

Performance & Scalability.name: Compliance Report Generation Performance
Performance & Scalability.definition: Latency, timeouts, concurrency load testing, queuing, and rate/usage limits affecting on-demand compliance report generation in Comply and its API.
